Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium high-fidelity redesigned desktop screenshot of AXVARIS, a local network evidence investigation application. This is an image reference for later implementation, not a promotional poster. Landscape desktop aspect about 5:3, target 2560 x 1536, razor sharp UI and fully readable Spanish text.
DESIGN WORLD: inspired by the operational clarity of Palantir Gotham, dense but calm, exceptionally precise professional analytical software. Keep the original warm monochrome palette: background #101010, sidebar #151413, surfaces #1d1a18, fine rules #3d3a39, secondary text #b8b3b0, primary #eeeeee. Existing green #a0ca92 for live capture/home and existing orange #ee6018 only for changed/selected evidence. No cyan, blue, purple, neon, rainbow or ornamental color. Preserve the elegant white serif X AXVARIS wordmark. Geist-like sans for UI and Geist Mono only for IPs, ports, timestamps, numbers. Primary text and metadata must both be clear, no gray-on-gray tiny type.
SHELL consistent across all references: narrow refined left sidebar about 200px at a 1920px viewport, five entries in order Hoy, En vivo, Investigar, Exposición, Datos y estado with crisp thin outline icons and clear active fill. Elegant low-height top toolbar with current area, search labelled Buscar, single capture dropdown, recording icon, command icon and settings icon. Compact bottom measurement strip. Do not duplicate capture state as both a label and a dropdown. Exclude white Windows titlebar and screenshot desktop/taskbar. Product viewport fills image edge to edge.
LIQUID GLASS: use restrained smoked transparent glass with soft backdrop blur, subtle refractive edge, bright fine rim and warm reflections for floating controls, view switches and transient menus. Keep data tables and primary evidence surfaces matte and readable. No bubble-like giant pills; proportionate 8-14px corners, exceptional alignment, measured spacing, thin internal separators.
CONTENT DISCIPLINE: use only factual data and functions provided by the target screenshot. Preserve unknown/zero/absent values honestly. Do not invent risk scores, malware verdicts, geographical destinations, fake traffic, alerts, new statuses, new features or random graphs. No promotional slogans, AI filler, uppercase category kickers, redundant explanatory paragraphs, decorative tags such as secure/verified/operational. Short useful original labels in Spanish. State can be rendered only when actually present in the original. Reduce duplicated prose into compact metadata or contextual detail. Visualization must convey an existing relationship or value rather than decoration.
COMPOSITION: this must visibly improve the source, not just reskin it. Stronger type hierarchy, significantly better scanability, better use of width, clear selection, actions next to their object, concise copy, no excessive empty space, no clipping, no illegible pseudo text, no mockup laptop frame, no watermark. Keep all five navigation areas and all existing relevant actions. One coherent app screen, no collage or before/after.
